summary: Camera trajectories control viewpoint changes in video generation, scene reconstruction, and robotic perception. Generating them from language requires both scene geometry and target-aware framing.
takeaways: We introduce OmniCam, an autoregressive model that generates camera pose sequences from a single panorama and textual trajectory descriptions.
On the reported OmniCaT evaluation, OmniCam reduces trajectory errors by 28--47% and collision rate by 65.8% relative to GenDoP retrained on OmniCaT.
Generating them from language requires both scene geometry and target-aware framing.
